entries.summary: New switch, Show pause button, under Settings > Menus. It adds a widget button that pauses your fake location and resumes it at the same place. It replaces the press-and-hold menu on the round button. It is off by default and does not show on the floating map.
The floating map now hides Favorites, Roaming and Search when you turn them off for the map in Settings > Menus.
New switches under Settings > Menus hide the share button and the north arrow on the floating map. Both are on by default.
Capture now has its own widget button. It is off by default. Turn it on in Settings, Menus. It replaces the press-and-hold shortcut on the paste button.
Large GPX routes now import. A GPS Joystick export with thousands of points no longer gets skipped.
